sh -c 'if [ -z "$SHELL" ] || [ ! -x "$SHELL" ]; then echo "Codex remote SSH requires SHELL to point to an executable login shell" >&2; exit 127; fi; CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD="$1"; export CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD; case "${SHELL##*/}" in csh|tcsh) exec "$SHELL" -i -c '\''set loginsh=1; if ( -r /etc/csh.login ) source /etc/csh.login; if ( -r ~/.login ) source ~/.login; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; nu) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c $env.CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD'\'' ;; fish|xonsh) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; *) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; export CODEX_HOME; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; esac' sh 'printf '\''%b'\'' '\''\234\077\102\274\134\323\277\254'\''; PATH="${CODEX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; export PATH; listeners=$(awk '\''$4 == "0A" && $2 ~ /:F596$/ {print $2}'\'' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6) || exit 1
[ "$listeners" = '\''0100007F:F596'\'' ] || exit 1
if [ -S "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK:-}" ]; then ln -sfn -- "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock"; elif [ ! -S "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock" ]; then rm -f -- "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock"; fi && exec codex app-server proxy'
